workload.description: FMCW range–Doppler detection, 256 samples per chirp, 128 chirps per frame, 4 RX channels, FP32 complex, with at most 16 PEs. Search the array, functional units, compiler settings, and memory organization.

proposals.reasoning: Balanced 16-tile mesh with distributed FMul for FFT/power and Ld/St for memory bandwidth.
